title: Yang-Xin-Shu-Mai granule alleviates atherosclerosis by regulating macrophage polarization via the TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Huang, Hong; Sun, Zeqi; Xu, Junyao; Wang, Linjie; Zhao, Jing; Li, Jie; Zhang, Siqi; Yuan, Fang; Liu, Ming; Fang, Zhuyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药颗粒通过TLR9/MyD88/NF-kB通路调控巨噬细胞极化治疗动脉粥样硬化，仅涉及分子对接作为辅助验证，核心为湿实验与信号通路，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Previous studies have found that Yang-Xin-Shu-Mai granule (YXSMG) has certain advantages in the treatment of stable coronary heart disease. However, YXSMG can inhibit the progression of atherosclerotic plaque and stabilize vulnerable plaque needs to be further explored and studied. This research, mass spectrometry analysis, network pharmacology, in vivo and in vitro experimental studies were conducted to explore the mechanism of YXSMG on atherosclerosis. AIM OF THE STUDY: To decipher the mechanism of atherosclerotic plaque, stabilization for YXSMG by analysis of its active ingredients and biological network and activity in whole animal and at cellular and molecular levels. METHODS: The active components of YXSMG were determined using high performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry/mass spectrometry (HPLC-MS/MS) analysis. The 'Disease-Compound-Target-Pathway' network diagram was constructed using network pharmacology, and the stability of binding between core targets and core compounds was analyzed with molecular docking. After intervention with YXSMG, the pathology of aortic plaque, inflammation in the surrounding tissue, expression of TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway protein in plaque and M1/M2 polarization of plaque macrophages were evaluated in vivo in apolipoprotein E-deficient (ApoE(-/-)) mice fed with high-fat diet. To verify whether it suppressed inflammation by inhibiting Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) reprogramming of macrophage polarization, we used RAW264.7 macrophages treated with specific TLR9 agonist (ODN1826) and inhibitor (ODN2088). RESULTS: Five active compounds were identified in YXSMG: catechin, formononetin, tanshinone IIA, cryptotanshinone and glycitein. Network pharmacology studies revealed TLR9 as one of the core targets of YXSMG intervention in atherosclerosis. Computer simulation of molecular docking showed that TLR9 could interact with the core compound to form a stable complex. In vivo experiments confirmed that YXSMG could significantly inhibit atherosclerotic plaque, reduce levels of blood lipids and inflammatory factors, downregulate TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway protein and inhibit aortic sinus macrophages polarization to M1, but promote their polarization to M2 to inhibit inflammation. In vitro experiments revealed that YXSMG could downregulate expression of TLR9 gene and protein in ODN1826-activated RAW264.7 macrophages. ODN2088 had a synergistic effect with YXSMG on the TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, and reprogrammed macrophages polarization from M1 to M2 by inhibiting TLR9, thus reducing immuno-inflammatory response. CONCLUSION: YXSMG can reduce the level of blood lipid and improve the size of atherosclerotic plaque and inflammatory infiltration in ApoE(-/-) mice fed with high fat. It is concluded that YXSMG can improve the mechanism of atherosclerotic plaque by inhibiting TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway reprogramming macrophage M1/M2 polarization and reducing arterial inflammation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：既往研究发现养心舒脉颗粒（YXSMG）在治疗稳定性冠心病方面具有一定优势。然而，YXSMG能否抑制动脉粥样硬化斑块进展并稳定易损斑块仍需进一步探索和研究。本研究通过质谱分析、网络药理学、体内及体外实验研究，探讨YXSMG对动脉粥样硬化的作用机制。研究目的：通过分析YXSMG的活性成分、生物网络及其在整体动物和细胞、分子水平的活性，阐明其稳定动脉粥样硬化斑块的机制。方法：采用高效液相色谱-质谱/质谱（HPLC-MS/MS）分析测定YXSMG的活性成分。利用网络药理学构建“疾病-化合物-靶点-通路”网络图，并通过分子对接分析核心靶点与核心化合物之间的结合稳定性。在体内实验中，对喂食高脂饮食的载脂蛋白E缺陷（ApoE(-/-)）小鼠进行YXSMG干预后，评估主动脉斑块病理、周围组织炎症、斑块中TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路蛋白表达及斑块巨噬细胞M1/M2极化情况。为验证其是否通过抑制Toll样受体9（TLR9）重编程巨噬细胞极化来抑制炎症，我们使用特异性TLR9激动剂（ODN1826）和抑制剂（ODN2088）处理RAW264.7巨噬细胞。结果：在YXSMG中鉴定出五种活性化合物：儿茶素、芒柄花素、丹参酮IIA、隐丹参酮和黄豆黄素。网络药理学研究揭示TLR9是YXSMG干预动脉粥样硬化的核心靶点之一。分子对接的计算机模拟显示，TLR9能与核心化合物相互作用形成稳定复合物。体内实验证实，YXSMG能显著抑制动脉粥样硬化斑块，降低血脂和炎症因子水平，下调TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路蛋白，并抑制主动脉窦巨噬细胞向M1极化，但促进其向M2极化以抑制炎症。体外实验显示，YXSMG能下调ODN1826激活的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中TLR9基因和蛋白的表达。ODN2088与YXSMG在TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路上具有协同作用，并通过抑制TLR9重编程巨噬细胞从M1向M2极化，从而减少免疫炎症反应。结论：YXSMG能降低高脂喂养的ApoE(-/-)小鼠的血脂水平，改善动脉粥样硬化斑块大小和炎症浸润。结论认为，YXSMG通过抑制TLR9/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路重编程巨噬细胞M1/M2极化并减少动脉炎症，从而改善动脉粥样硬化斑块的机制。
